cards.prompt: Prevent further changes to a record once its Status is set to 'Archived'.
options: Custom Visualforce page overriding the layout
Sharing rule that changes access based on Status
cards.why: PRIORVALUE(Status) = 'Archived' blocks every later save. ISCHANGED only catches the moment Status changes, so later edits slip through.
cards.traps: Sharing rules only grant access; Visualforce is code when a declarative option exists.

cards.prompt: A new SMB line joins Enterprise; each account type records different information and reps work one or the other. (2)
options: Use FLS on SMB fields to restrict access
Create an SMB record type and assign it to the right reps' profile
Add a picklist to distinguish SMB and Enterprise
Create an SMB page layout and assign it to the right reps' profile
answer: Create an SMB record type and assign it to the right reps' profile
Create an SMB page layout and assign it to the right reps' profile
cards.why: Record type + page layout keep the two kinds of account separate. A picklist or FLS doesn't control which record type a user works with.
cards.strip: Two kinds of the same record → record type + page layout.

cards.prompt: A terminated rep is the sole recipient of an email alert. How do you stop them logging in?
cards.why: A user who is the sole recipient of an email alert can't be deactivated right away. Freezing blocks login immediately.
cards.traps: Users can never be deleted.

cards.prompt: Considerations when changing a custom field's type. (3)
options: Data loss may occur depending on the new type
List views based on the field may be deleted
Custom field types can't be changed
Assignment and escalation rules may be affected
The type can change even if a roll-up summary references it
answer: Data loss may occur depending on the new type
List views based on the field may be deleted
Assignment and escalation rules may be affected
cards.why: Type changes are allowed but can lose data, delete list views that use the field, and break rules that reference it.
cards.traps: A roll-up reference must be removed first.

cards.prompt: How do you create a relationship between two cases?
options: Set one case as the Parent Case of the other
Select cases in a list view and click Related
Add each case to a Case Relationships related list
answer: Set one case as the Parent Case of the other
cards.why: The Parent Case lookup links them; 'View Case Hierarchy' shows the tree.
cards.traps: Related Case field, the list view button, and Case Relationships list don't exist.

cards.prompt: Key features of Einstein Search in Lightning. (3)
options: Uses results indexed by other search engines
Instant results show every record containing the value
Actions available by hovering over instant results
answer: Actions available by hovering over instant results
cards.why: Personalization, natural language, and actionable instant results.
cards.traps: Instant results only match record names (and searchable secondary fields), not every field.

cards.prompt: What's required to model many-to-many between two custom objects? (2)
cards.why: A junction object with two master-detail fields, one to each object.
cards.traps: Lookups don't have to be filled in; hierarchical is User-only.

cards.prompt: True about campaign hierarchies. (3)
options: Each campaign can have one parent
Each campaign can only have five siblings
A hierarchy groups campaigns within one marketing initiative
View it with the 'View Campaign Hierarchy' button
A campaign can have multiple parents
answer: Each campaign can have one parent
A hierarchy groups campaigns within one marketing initiative
View it with the 'View Campaign Hierarchy' button
cards.why: One parent, unlimited siblings, up to 5 levels deep.
cards.traps: 'Five' is the level limit, not siblings.

cards.prompt: Hardware vs. software repair cases need different record types and support processes. Which is correct?
options: A Case record type must exist before a Support Process
Case Stages must be defined before a Support Process
A Support Process must exist before a Case record type
New Case Statuses can be created while creating a Support Process
answer: A Support Process must exist before a Case record type
cards.why: Each Case record type is tied to an existing support process, so the process comes first.

cards.prompt: A record-triggered flow won't save. What helps troubleshoot?
cards.why: Lists what blocks saving or activation and jumps to the element.
cards.traps: Debug runs a flow that already saves; Trigger Explorer lists flows on an object.

cards.prompt: The Account page loads slowly. What can the admin do?
options: Enable separate loading of related lists
Enable quick load on the page layout
answer: Enable separate loading of related lists
cards.why: Record details load first, related lists after.

cards.prompt: Duplicate contacts exist under different accounts. Fix?
options: Tell the Director there's no error: one contact per account
Update the contacts' accounts because people changed jobs
Enable Contacts to Multiple Accounts and set direct and indirect accounts
Create a validation rule to block duplicates
answer: Enable Contacts to Multiple Accounts and set direct and indirect accounts
cards.why: One contact, related to several accounts.

cards.prompt: Features of Pipeline Inspection. (3)
options: Only one record type's opportunities can be edited inline
A 'Pipeline' tab shows forecast category changes over time
Filters narrow the view or highlight concerns
KPI metrics at the top of the page
Tiered Einstein opportunity scores with key factors
answer: Filters narrow the view or highlight concerns
KPI metrics at the top of the page
Tiered Einstein opportunity scores with key factors
cards.why: Metrics, filtered views, weekly changes, and Einstein insights.
cards.traps: Category changes over time are on the 'Flow' tab (with Revenue Intelligence), and inline editing now follows the page layout.

cards.prompt: Route cases to skilled agents while respecting how many each can handle.
cards.why: Routes work by size and agent capacity (and skills).
cards.traps: Assignment rules ignore workload; queues hold work but don't push it.

cards.prompt: Logging in to Data Loader from an IP not in trusted ranges requires: (2)
cards.why: Password + security token when the IP isn't trusted.
cards.traps: OAuth is optional; no captcha.

cards.prompt: Only allow the account 'VIP' checkbox to be saved if the account has opportunities with premium bundle products.
options: Validation rule on Account checking opportunities and products
Quick action that launches a checking flow
Fault path that shows an error
Custom Error element in a flow
answer: Custom Error element in a flow
cards.why: Validation rules can't look at child records. A record-triggered flow can, and the Custom Error element blocks the save with a message.
cards.traps: Fault paths handle system errors; a quick action can't stop a save.

cards.prompt: Steps after enabling multi-currency. (3)
options: Set validity dates for exchange rates
cards.why: Dated rates need Advanced Currency Management (optional). Currency is per user, not profile.

cards.prompt: Which object's record types don't need a business process first?
cards.why: Business processes exist only for Lead, Opportunity, Case, Solution; Campaign has none.

cards.prompt: A user can't find an email template. Why? (2)
options: User lacks read/write access to the template
User lacks access to the template folder
answer: User lacks access to the template folder
cards.why: Templates need 'Available for Use' and folder access.

cards.prompt: Steps in setting up Web-to-Lead. (3)
cards.why: Route leads, map custom fields for conversion, and reply automatically.
cards.traps: Without an active assignment rule, web leads go to the default lead owner.

cards.prompt: Benefits of Open CTI. (3)
options: Calls from the Salesforce UI with a customizable softphone
Cloud-based but softphone only in IE and Chrome
Screen pops with the matching record on incoming calls
Uses CTI adapters installed on user machines
answer: Calls from the Salesforce UI with a customizable softphone
Screen pops with the matching record on incoming calls
cards.why: Click-to-dial, customizable softphone, screen pops; browser-based, no adapters.

cards.prompt: Simplest way to send a report to all employees daily.
options: Schedule it to a public group containing all users
Schedule it and add every user
answer: Schedule it to a public group containing all users
cards.why: The 'All Internal Users' group updates itself when users are added.

cards.prompt: Valid consideration when debugging a record-triggered flow with Debug.
options: Rollback can be disabled to save changes
Can run as a specified user for create, update, or delete
An existing record can be used only for update triggers
Only required fields can be set
answer: Can run as a specified user for create, update, or delete
cards.why: 'Run flow as another user' (enable it in Process Automation Settings; sandbox/dev only).
cards.traps: Rollback is always on; existing records work for update and delete; optional fields can be set too.

cards.prompt: Help two divisions tell their Lightning apps apart and find their own products. (2)
options: Sharing rules to hide the other division's products
Different brand images and colors per app
answer: Different brand images and colors per app
cards.why: App branding makes them distinct; a pinned, role-shared list view becomes each division's default.
cards.traps: Sharing rules can't restrict; app access is by profile, not role.

cards.prompt: Add or update Campaign Members from the Campaign record page.
cards.why: 'Manage Campaign Members' and 'Import Leads and Contacts' open the Data Import Wizard (up to 50,000).
cards.traps: Campaign Update Wizard is retired; the button doesn't exist.

cards.prompt: True about managing tasks in Lightning. (2)
options: Tasks can't be deleted from a list view
Drag tasks between status columns in Kanban
Split view shows two tasks side by side
Tasks can be shown in a table view
answer: Drag tasks between status columns in Kanban
Tasks can be shown in a table view
cards.why: Views: Table, Kanban, Split. Split shows the list next to one task's details.

cards.prompt: Update the owner of an opportunity owned by an inactive user.
cards.why: Enable it in User Interface settings, then grant the permission.

cards.prompt: Automatically update Discount on opportunities when created or updated, based on Expected Revenue.
cards.why: Same-record field update = record-triggered flow (before-save is fastest).

cards.prompt: Mass-transferring accounts moves which by default? (2)
cards.why: Contacts, open opportunities, draft contracts and orders, notes, attachments, and open activities move. Cases are optional; completed activities never move.

cards.prompt: Give external users extra permissions for six months, removed automatically after.
options: Permission set with an expiration date
answer: Permission set with an expiration date
cards.why: Permission set assignments can expire. One set covers everyone.

cards.prompt: What does AgentExchange offer?
cards.why: Agent building blocks.

cards.prompt: True about dashboard refresh. (3)
options: After a scheduled refresh it can be emailed to a group
It refreshes every time it's displayed
It can be scheduled daily, weekly, or monthly
The refresh is emailed to everyone by default
answer: After a scheduled refresh it can be emailed to a group
It can be scheduled daily, weekly, or monthly
cards.why: Manual or scheduled; emails go only to chosen recipients with access.

cards.prompt: In a screen flow, automatically load an account's open cases into a data table when the account is picked, on the same screen.
cards.why: Screen Actions run an autolaunched flow when an input changes, with no click.
cards.traps: Action Button needs a click.

cards.prompt: Private sharing model: features that grant exceptions to Account access. (3)
cards.why: All three open record access.
cards.traps: 'Sharing exception rules' don't exist; field permissions are field-level.

cards.prompt: Setting up a Chatter group customers can join.
options: Any member can invite customers by email
Access type must be Public or Private
cards.why: The setting is required. Only owners or managers can invite, and unlisted groups can include customers.

cards.prompt: After adding a new Opportunity field, what's true about report types? (2)
options: Auto-added to all custom report types
Auto-added to all standard Opportunity report types
Can't be added to 'Opportunities with Accounts'
answer: Auto-added to all standard Opportunity report types
cards.why: New fields land in standard report types automatically. Custom report types need the field added (or the auto-add setting).
cards.traps: 'Opportunities with Accounts' isn't standard, so it's custom: the field can be added manually.

cards.prompt: Total a cross-object formula field (Product Cost) from Opportunity Products onto the Opportunity.
options: Record-triggered flow to copy the cost + roll-up summary
Roll-up summary on the formula field
answer: Record-triggered flow to copy the cost + roll-up summary
cards.why: Roll-ups can't summarize cross-object formulas, so copy the value into a currency field first.

cards.prompt: Where can an admin see a user's login attempts? (3)
options: Login History related list on the user record
User Detail section of the user record
answer: Login History related list on the user record
User Detail section of the user record
cards.why: Login History (page and related list) logs attempts; User Detail shows last login.
cards.traps: 'Login Attempts' and 'Login Security' pages don't exist.

cards.prompt: Report on feed activity on records.
cards.why: Custom report type with the object's Feed as a secondary object.

cards.prompt: When a quote is accepted, create a draft agreement and a follow-up task.
cards.why: Record-triggered flow creating related records.

cards.prompt: Action Type for an object-specific quick action that launches an LWC.
cards.why: 'Lightning Component' is for Aura.

cards.prompt: Valid Einstein Activity Capture metric fields for email reporting. (2)
cards.why: Activity metrics are being retired starting Summer '26.

cards.prompt: Remind 30 minutes before a daily event stored in a Time field.
options: Hourly scheduled flow with text filters
Store it in a Time data type resource
Convert to text and compare strings
answer: Store it in a Time data type resource
cards.why: Flow's Time data type compares times directly.

cards.prompt: True about Data Loader. (2)
cards.why: See reference links.

cards.prompt: Stop notifications from some Chatter posts in the mobile app.
cards.why: Muting stops notifications unless you're @mentioned again.

cards.prompt: Send approved leave details to an internal employee portal from an approval process.
cards.why: Outbound messages post data to an external endpoint.

cards.prompt: True about list views in Lightning. (2)
options: All objects' list views can be printed
Users only see data they can access
Records owned by subordinates are excluded
answer: Users only see data they can access
cards.why: List views follow sharing and FLS; subordinates' records are included.

cards.prompt: Get all accounts as CSV in Lightning. (3)
cards.why: Export 'details only' for CSV. Save As copies the report; Printable View is PDF.

cards.prompt: Add a filter to an existing public list view with 3 filters.
options: Users with 'Manage Public List Views' can edit it and add filters
Admin must enable the permission, max 5 filters
answer: Users with 'Manage Public List Views' can edit it and add filters
cards.why: Filter count isn't a permission or allocation.

cards.prompt: A new picklist value isn't visible on a particular record.
options: Not added to that record's record type
Profile needs access to the value
Not added to all record types
answer: Not added to that record's record type
cards.why: Values are set per record type; they don't need to be on all of them. New values start active; profiles don't control values.

cards.prompt: Must be provisioned before turning on Einstein generative AI.
cards.why: Data Cloud underpins features including the Trust Layer.

cards.prompt: Quickly validate updated Topic instructions inside Agent Builder.
cards.why: Light, interactive testing before publishing.

cards.prompt: Visual summary of a rep's opportunities by stage.
cards.why: Max 200 cards, 4 fields per card. Path is one record.

cards.prompt: Route installation cases to level 3 reps, and notify the manager when a platinum case is unresolved after 3 hours. (2)
options: Flow that moves unresolved platinum cases to managers
Escalation rule action notifying the manager
Assignment rule sending installation cases to level 3
Escalation rule action setting priority to platinum
answer: Escalation rule action notifying the manager
Assignment rule sending installation cases to level 3
cards.why: Assignment = owner; escalation = time-based notify or reassign. Escalation can't update fields.

cards.prompt: Keep sensitive data out of Web-to-Case failure notifications.
cards.why: See reference links.

cards.prompt: Where can a record ID be found? (3)
cards.why: See reference links.

cards.prompt: Report of opportunities grouped by stage.
cards.why: One grouping = Summary; Matrix is rows and columns.

cards.prompt: Is data in Agentforce conversations masked like other Einstein generative AI features?
options: Pattern- and field-based masking is disabled for agents
All agent conversations are masked the same way
answer: Pattern- and field-based masking is disabled for agents
cards.why: Masking is off for agents for performance and accuracy.

cards.prompt: An active agent is invisible to users. Likely cause?
cards.why: Access to an agent is granted by permission set.

cards.prompt: Key difference between traditional bots and Agentforce Service Agent.
options: Bots follow scripts with human help; Agentforce reasons and acts autonomously
Both are scripted; Agentforce needs more training data
Bots are autonomous; Agentforce only routes to humans
answer: Bots follow scripts with human help; Agentforce reasons and acts autonomously
cards.why: See reference links.
